test_cases.name: full_5_step_flow
test_cases.input: /review-session (session used dataflywheel, user corrected a missing partition filter)
assertions: Step 1: produces correction trace table with mistake score
Step 2: audits dataflywheel with 7 questions, produces change plan table
Step 3: tunes SKILL.md AND adds eval to evals.json
Step 4: runs validate-skill.py on touched skills and fixes failures
Step 5: verifies changes look correct — does NOT skip this step
Does NOT create or edit any CHANGELOG.md

test_cases.name: creates_new_skill_on_3x_pattern
test_cases.input: review-session: I kept writing the same Axiom query pattern 3 sessions in a row
assertions: Identifies the 3x repetition pattern
Creates new skill directory with SKILL.md and evals/
Writes real evals.json and triggers.json (3+ test cases, not stubs)
Creates skill directory in .grok/skills/

test_cases.name: traces_repeated_corrections
test_cases.input: review-session: user told me twice to check the branch before committing
assertions: Records 2 rows in correction trace (once per repetition)
Identifies root cause
TUNEs the commit skill to add branch check

test_cases.name: grows_triggers_and_evals
test_cases.input: review-session: user triggered the skill by saying 'what did we learn' but that wasn't in triggers
assertions: Adds 'what did we learn' to triggers.json with should_trigger: true

test_cases.name: asks_which_agent_ran_session
assertions: Asks whether the session ran in Claude Code or Grok before Step 1
Does NOT start tracing or read any transcript before the user answers

test_cases.name: claude_code_session_loads_reference
test_cases.input: /review-session for my last Claude Code session
assertions: Reads references/claude-code-sessions.md before Step 1
Finds the transcript under ~/.claude/projects/, not .grok/
Does NOT write to .grok/skills/

test_cases.name: records_everything_in_the_project
test_cases.input: /review-session for this Claude Code session (user corrected the commit skill once and a CLAUDE.md rule once)
assertions: Records the review, the commit-skill finding and the CLAUDE.md finding in <project>/.review-session/
Records the commit-skill finding with --target skill --skill commit
Does NOT write any record into the commit skill's folder
Still applies the TUNE itself to the commit skill's source SKILL.md
Adds one dated line to the project's existing WORKLOG.md or CHANGELOG.md, and does NOT create a new one

test_cases.name: repeat_tune_escalates_instead_of_patching
test_cases.input: /review-session (stats.py status shows SKILL.md of the commit skill in repeat_tunes)
assertions: Runs stats.py status before writing the change plan
Rewrites the whole section or adds an eval, script or hook
Does NOT append another one-line rule to the same section
